trials.claim: 1 Code costs $89 with lifetime access to WordHero
trials.claimQuote:
### 1 Code: $89 (was $2088)
- Lifetime access to WordHero
- All future Pro Plan updates
trials.reasoning: Two buyers say the $89 package excludes the editor and demands $59 more for it, materially limiting the advertised lifetime access, even though one buyer confirms the $89 purchase price.

exhibits.quote: When I logged in to the writer panel/area it says to pay $59 extra more to get access to the editor tool.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows lifetime access for $89 still requires extra payment for core editor access.

exhibits.quote: This package does not come with the EDITOR mode which is a must have if you are looking to write blog content.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows the base package excludes a must-have mode, undermining lifetime access as advertised.

exhibits.quote: I came across the word hero lifetime deal on app sumo and just a few mins ago I purchased this lifetime deal for $89.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms purchasing the WordHero lifetime deal for $89.

trials.claim: 3 Codes includes unlimited GPT-3.5 tokens per month
trials.claimQuote:
- Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
- Unlimited GPT-3.5 tokens per month
- 10,000 GPT-4 tokens per month
trials.reasoning: The single review says chat showed an upsell, but it does not state the buyer had 3 codes or had used their GPT-3.5 token allowance, so it is too weak to prove or disprove unlimited tokens for that tier.

exhibits.quote: I can't even chat. All it does when I try is throw a promo page in my face trying to get more money.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports chat is blocked by upsell demands, contradicting unlimited monthly tokens.
